items.objective: Explore a two-pass AVX-512 argmin: first compute the global signed int32 minimum; then scan from index zero with vector equality comparisons to find the earliest matching element, extracting the lowest matching lane and handling a scalar tail. Preserve first-index ties and INT32 extrema. Do not change the frozen compiler, target, or protocol; verify this code builds and is valid on the supplied target. Check correctness before comparing repeated timings, particularly on random and decreasing inputs where the second-pass search length may differ.
